title: Car vs cyclist, call 2 of 2 (driver)

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I hit someone. I hit a cyclist with my car, oh God, he came out of nowhere.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: The roundabout by the big ICA, Getingevägen.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: We have an ambulance on the way to that accident already, someone else called. Are you hurt?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I don't know. The airbag went off. My chest hurts when I breathe in. I'm okay, I'm okay, it's him.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: He opened his eyes a bit. He's asking what happened, again and again. Someone is holding his head.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Okay, that's good information. How fast were you driving?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Maybe forty? Forty, fifty. I was braking.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Please sit down somewhere safe, away from the traffic, and stay there. The ambulance crew will check you too.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I'm shaking. I can't stop shaking.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: That's normal after a shock. Sit down, breathe slowly. Help is almost there.
